text.en:
Except for the foregoing amendment, all other provisions
of Executive Order No. 423 shall remain unchanged.

This Executive Order shall lake effed immediately upon
its publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila this 31stday of July
Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
in the year of Our
Ry The President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Exactlive Secretary
